title: ‘Cyberpunk Edgerunners II’ Is A Thrilling If Unwieldy Return To Night City
description: Cyberpunk Edgerunners took millions by surprise when it released in 2022. It quickly became one of the most-watched anime on Netflix and a pop culture phenomenon due to its potent blend of hyperviolence and emotional devastation. Any time I come across a TikTok with “ I Really Want to Stay At Your House ” as the audio, I preemptively prepare to have my heart absolutely shattered.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Here Are The Best Horror Games To Wrap Up Spooky Season
description: With Halloween falling on a Saturday this year, it’s the perfect time to boot a horror game you can easily knock out over the weekend. Here are some recommendations! Almost Every Resident Evil Game When it comes to spooky season, you can’t go wrong with booting up a Resident Evil game. This has been gaming’s marquee horror franchise for a reason: it generally delivers.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Where To Find The Year’s Best Horror Movies On Streaming
description: While I do love me some Christmas, I’ve always considered spooky season to be the most wonderful time of the year. Lucky for me, 2026 has been a banner year for horror movies, and we’ve still got plenty more to come out. Here’s where you can find some of the year’s best horror movies so far on streaming. 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple Director Nia DaCosta kicked the year off with a bang with 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Separating Shawn Carter The Businessman From Jay-Z The Business, Man
description: After years of helping the NFL select its halftime performers through his Roc Nation partnership, which was conveniently created during the time of former quarterback Colin Kaepernick’s kneeling protest in support of the movement for Black lives, Jay-Z has finally decided the biggest stage in American sports needs what it has apparently been missing all along: more Jay-Z. The man who helped pick the headliners has picked himself. That is certainly one way to celebrate 30 years in the business.
author: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.

title: Joe Nerds Out: Pouring One Out For BioWare
description: If you’re a gamer of a certain age, you most likely felt some kind of way last week when it was announced that BioWare, the legendary game studio behind Dragon Age, Mass Effect, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, was being shut down. I cannot express how big of a role BioWare played in my childhood. I’ve always been a huge Japanese Role-Playing Game (JRPG) fan ever since I was gifted a copy of Final Fantasy IX when I was eight years old.
author: Joe Jurado

title: The GOP Is Staging Klan Rallies Across The Country To Win The Midterms. Let Me Explain
description: I’ve written about this before — multiple times , actually — but it’s ironic and interesting that Republican conservatives go out of their way to highlight the history that members of the early iterations of the Ku Klux Klan identified politically as Democrats. I find it equally interesting that in response to Republicans isolating that history from the broader historical context, liberal Democrats always bring up the party switch : the gradual process in which our two major political parties es…
author: Zack Linly

title: ICE Agent Who Struck Migrant With Vehicle Indicted By Texas Grand Jury
description: Another Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent is facing a legal battle in Texas over allegations of violence against a civilian, and many would agree it’s about time federal agents were held accountable for the chaos they’ve created in communities across the country, as a result of the Trump administration’s mass deportation agenda.
author: Zack Linly

title: Vivek Ramaswamy Pulls Attack Ad With Amy Acton’s Mother
description: After drawing the ire of damn near everybody, Vivek Ramaswamy’s campaign has stopped airing its controversial ad featuring the mother of his gubernatorial rival, Amy Acton. According to AP , Ramaswamy announced at a campaign rally on Thursday that the ad has finished its run on airwaves. This is a significantly shorter run than what the campaign intended. While the campaign originally put $4 million behind the ad, AdImpact data showed it spent roughly $1 million.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Drama Behind 2 Dan Sullivans In Alaska’s Senate Race Becomes Major Legal Dispute, But This Ain’t New
description: Ok, even I can admit that the Tale of Two Dans — the debacle involving two Republicans named Dan Sullivan, both running for a U.S. Senate seat to represent Alaska — has become more of a saga than I expected, but it’s still much ado about nothing. See, like many people, I figured Sen. Dan Sullivan, the Republican incumbent, was simply being trolled by Dan J.
author: Zack Linly

title: Would Iyanla Vanzant Invite R. Kelly To Her Thanksgiving?
description: As families finalize their Thanksgiving dinner invites, last year’s controversial debate around going no contact and cutting ties with difficult relatives has reemerged with an added layer about whether known predators should be invited to holiday family gatherings. Spiritual teacher Iyanla Vanzant’s recent suggestion during an interview that she and other elders in the Black community owe singer R.
author: Nicky Childers

title: Black Native Americans: The History Of A Shared & Complicated Legacy
description: Black Native Americans have always existed, yet their history remains one of the most overlooked and frequently misunderstood chapters of American history. Their stories are woven into the history of Indigenous nations, the transatlantic slave trade, colonialism, resistance, and the fight for freedom. But how did people of African descent become part of Native American tribes between the 1600s and 1800s? The answer is far more complex than many people realize.
author: Shannon Dawson

title: Trump Cancels Campaign Appearances In Kansas And Iowa. Oh, Wait, Nevermind
description: You know what’s funny about President Donald Trump? He’s a man with a gigantic ego, who is observably obsessed with how he’s perceived by the general public, and while that obsession never influences him to — oh, I don’t know — be a half-decent human being for even a millisecond of his life, it does influence his day-to-day and even hour-to-hour decisions, making him an annoying person for a simple news writer like myself to keep up with.
author: Zack Linly

title: November Is Coming: Here Are Some Ways Trump Is Trying To Steal The Election
description: So far, the judicial branch of the United States government has done a consistent job of preventing President Donald Trump from manipulating and/or flat-out stealing the upcoming midterm elections. But the real story isn’t that federal judges are standing between voters and our democracy; the real story is that the president of the United States keeps forcing judges to play that role in the first place.
author: Zack Linly

title: Sir Patrick Stewart, Of X-Men And Star Trek Fame, Dies At 86
description: On Monday, Sir Patrick Stewart died at age 86 after a brief battle with Alzheimer’s disease. Deadline reports that Stewart’s representatives released a statement on Wednesday confirming his death. “We announce with great sorrow the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart yesterday at his home in Los Angeles, in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny, following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy Body Dementia,” the statement reads.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Hackers Leak Identifying Info Of 41,000 DHS Employees
description: Well, it appears that the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) is learning that if you play stupid games, you win stupid prizes. After spending the last year concealing basic identifying information of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents, DHS has been subject to a massive leak exposing the information of 41,000 employees, including some undercover ICE agents. Wired reports that the hacktivist group Department of Peace has claimed credit for the leak.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Anti-MAGA Troll Compares Trump Rally To Jonestown On Fox News
description: In today’s episode of Not All Heroes Wear Capes, And None Of Them Wear MAGA Hats , a Fox News host has gone viral for getting eloquently trolled by a man he thought was a Trump supporter at a GOP rally in Rock Hill, South Carolina. It really was a master class in in-person trolling by a white man who knew he could be anti-MAGA and hide in plain sight among the Caucasian troglodytes he, like many, believes have formed a cult.
author: Zack Linly

title: District Judge Denies Trump Request To Withhold 20,000 California Ballots
description: I know the Trump administration has never seen Mean Girls because they keep trying to make fetch happen. A federal judge handed the administration another legal L after denying their request to withhold 20,000 mail-in ballots in California. Fetch is not happening, folks. AP reports that the Trump administration filed a lawsuit asking a district court to withhold 20,000 ballots belonging to folks they believe are likely non-citizens.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Vice President JD Vance Doesn’t Understand Ranked-Choice Voting
description: In the Arkham Asylum simulation that is America – you know the one in which the asylum is running the White House – the real live Vice President, the one that can’t make it through IKEA without inappropriately fondling the sofas, just admitted in front of God and err’body that he doesn’t know what ranked-choice voting is, and I want to burn it all to the ground.
author: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.

title: The 2 Dan Sullivans, 1 Senate Seat, And An Alleged Democratic Plot To Flip Congress
description: The tale of the two Dan Sullvans in Alaska, both vying for the same US Senate seat, just got a bit more nefarious. According to an extensive investigation published by The New York Times, it appears that what was once seen as a historic troll of the ages–a man with the same name as an incumbent entering the race for Congress if only to draw votes from the actual Dan Sullivan–might actually have been spearheaded by Democrats looking to take over Congress.
author: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.

title: Obama Responds To MAGA Crashout Over Cheesecake Factory Joke, And It Was Masterful
description: Former President Barack Obama campaigned for Sen. Jon Ossoff (D-Ga.) and gubernatorial candidate Keisha Lance Bottoms in Atlanta on Wednesday, and he took the time to address the MAGA fallout over his jab at President Donald Trump’s obsession with renovating the White House, and the gaudy, tacky way he has gone about it. And, boy, did he address it.
author: Zack Linly

title: Elon Musk Attempting To Buy Up Homes In Southaven, Mississippi, After Data Center Complaints
description: One really has to wonder whether billionaire tech bro Elon Musk is intentionally a living, breathing composite of every movie villain ever. He’s already a racist , Nazi salute-waving , white nationalist , who funds the campaigns of racist politicians, whose only Black friends were his servants (allegedly), and whose fraud detection department turned out to be a fraud in itself .
author: Zack Linly

title: Alex Pretti’s Parents Say Feds Stonewalling Investigation
description: While the GOP loves to tout itself as the “Law and Order Party,” that commitment apparently doesn’t extend to its own members. The parents of Alex Pretti held a news conference on Tuesday calling out the federal government for keeping them in the dark about the investigation into Pretti’s death. “At every turn, they have ignored us, misled us and shielded Alex’s killers,” Pretti’s father, Michael, said at the news conference in Minneapolis, alongside his wife, Susan.
author: Joe Jurado

title: NAACP Denounces El Paso Group Who Wore KKK Costumes
description: While I have gone on record as saying spooky season is the most wonderful time of the year, it also has its downsides. Like clockwork, white people use Halloween as an excuse to wear the most racist costumes imaginable. The El Paso, Texas chapter of the NAACP has spoken out after a group of teenagers in the city went viral for wearing KKK costumes.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Labor Activist And Civil Rights Icon Dolores Huerta Dies At 96
description: Dolores Huerta, co-founder of what became the United Farm Workers (UFW) union — the first nationally recognized union for farmworkers — has died at age 96. According to the New York Times , Huerta passed away Wednesday at her home in Bakersfield, California. Erik Olvera, a spokesman for her family, told the Times she died of cancer.
author: Zack Linly

title: RFK Jr. Claims Arabs ‘Don’t Produce Science’ Or Literature, Because White Nationalists Are Running The US
description: White America spent years — generations even — gaslighting Black people by accusing us of “race-baiting,” “playing the race card,” and hating white people every time we called out racism on either a systemic or individual level. How many times did we hear, “I don’t see color,” or “I don’t care if you’re Black, white, green, or purple,” or “I don’t have a racist bone in my body,” or that we Black people are the real racists for talking about racism?
author: Zack Linly

title: ICE Is Functioning As The New COINTELPRO, Report Finds
description: The Trump administration’s immigration crackdown is apparently about more than deportations. Newly revealed court documents suggest Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has been building an expansive surveillance operation targeting left-wing activists, community organizers and people protesting the administration’s policies. The evidence emerged after 15 Minnesota residents facing federal conspiracy charges tied to efforts to monitor immigration enforcement agents.
author: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.

title: The History Of Black Surnames In America: The Powerful Stories Behind The Names We Carry
description: A last name may look like a simple part of your identity, but for Black Americans, it can hold generations of history, survival, family separation, resistance and freedom. Some surnames connect families to the people who enslaved their ancestors. Others reflect the names people deliberately chose after emancipation to reclaim their identities and begin new chapters. And some carry stories that have been lost to time.
author: Shannon Dawson

title: Trump Declares He’s ‘BANNING’ The Term ‘AI,’ In Favor ‘Super Intelligence’
description: Do you know why so many people refuse to take President Donald Trump seriously as the fascist that he is? It’s because he’s such a comically idiotic fascist. Sure, he, openly denies certain people the right to due process, uses the military to attack U.S. citizens , ignores state sovereignty, declares imaginary leftist groups as terrorist organizations , deports people just for organizing or reporting on protests he disagrees with, spends nearly every waking moment spreading election fraud propa…
author: Zack Linly

title: ICE Has Held Black US Citizen Who Suffers Mental Illness In Custody For A Year, Court Records Show
description: America can complain and condemn the call for the complete abolition of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), but once they start arguing that people are calling for it for no reason, they’re just showing off their dedication to ignoring reality. The violence , the human rights abuses , the lies and cover-ups , the detaining and harassing of immigrants and U.S.
author: Zack Linly

title: 15-Year-Old Charged As Adult In Florida A&M Shooting
description: The 15-year-old who was arrested for a mass shooting last weekend outside Florida A&M that injured 11 people will be charged as an adult. CNN reports that State Attorney Jack Campbell told the outlet that Anthony Rivers III faces 11 counts of attempted second-degree murder and possession of a firearm by a delinquent in connection with a mass shooting.
author: Joe Jurado
